research_question: Does static K=4 branching improve repository-repair post-training independently of the policy used to vary environment complexity?

shared_configuration.fixed_budget_stop_policy: Disable outcome-triggered early stops for regression, uninformative groups, and maximum-level mastery; retain provider deadlines, final-evaluation reserve, protocol failure, and the exact completion budget.

scheduled_dynamic.promotion_rule: promote after every two completed validation windows
scheduled_dynamic.reason: Vary complexity dynamically while removing policy-outcome feedback from the level schedule.

scope: Remove fake file paths from action examples.
Require non-empty paths to be copied from an observation.
Return the current bounded file content when an exact edit target is stale or ambiguous.
Tell the policy to reread after a rejected edit before retrying.
motivating_evidence: revision-30 trajectories repeated stale exact-edit targets

external_evaluation.adapter_policy: evaluate every completed adapter and the frozen base policy
external_evaluation.disclosure_policy: do not inspect aggregate or task-level external outcomes until all 20 training conditions are terminal

estimands.branching_main_effect: Within-seed K=4 minus K=1 exact-solve-rate difference, averaged across curriculum policies.
estimands.curriculum_main_effect: Within-seed adaptive minus scheduled-dynamic exact-solve-rate difference, averaged across branch widths.
estimands.interaction: Difference between the branching effects under adaptive and scheduled-dynamic curricula.
estimands.post_training_effect: Each adapter's paired exact-solve change from the frozen base policy.

larger_model.initial_scope: one K=4 adaptive replication using the same completion budget and a new frozen split

reporting.terminal_outcome: PASS only when every required larger-model prerequisite gate passes; otherwise FAIL
